value.rationale: The new dual-positive hypergroup has known qualitative zero support but no quantified central Plancherel weight in the motivating text. That weight is the exact mass assigned to the zero character, determines the norm of its spectral projection in a probability decomposition, and responds by a nontrivial fractional-linear law to a one-site perturbation. The odd Euler product creates a usable closed reference invariant across a natural two-parameter construction; neither positivity nor spectral eigenvalue locations imply it.
